messages:
natalie: FYI were doing a coordinated docs + SDK broadcast tomorrow: small breaking change for the SDK config key `default_model` -> `model` + a docs refresh for the Quickstart. No runtime behavior changes, just normalized param names.

harold: Can you summarise the migration steps? We have a few customers that set default_model in infra templates.

natalie: Migration path: 1) SDKs will accept both keys for 30 days (deprecated warning logged). 2) Docs Quickstart will show the new canonical `model` key and a one-line shim: `config['model'] = config.pop('default_model', config.get('model'))`. 3) We'll publish a patch release for py/js/go tomorrow AM with the deprecation warning.

alisha: Will this affect Dedicated/Private deployments where infra templates are pinned? Need to add note for Support.

natalie: Good catch -> were adding a Support KB and a Console banner for org admins. For Dedicated/Private customers we will keep the shim for 90 days and offer a migration assist.

sdk-team: SDK plan: patch release (no API break) with dual-key support and a WARN log when default_model provided. After 30 days we cut a minor that errors if only default_model present.

harold: Any docs links I can forward to account teams?

natalie: Draft PR: docs#8380 contains Quickstart updates, migration snippet, and a sample terraform template. Also an admin-facing KB: support#612.

docs-bot: deploy: docs-site v4.2.1 -> staging (includes Quickstart updates and migration guide)

alisha: Timing? When will users start seeing warnings?

natalie: Patch SDKs publish tomorrow 0900 PT with warning enabled. Docs and KB will go live at the same time. Console banner for orgs targeted for rollout the same day at noon.

sdk-team: We'll add telemetry to track occurrences of the old key and send a weekly report to product+support.

harold: Sounds good. I'll update the customer migration checklist and ping account owners.

natalie: Action items: 1) SDKs publish + release notes (sdk-team) 2) Docs PR review (alisha, harold) 3) Support KB and console banner copy (alisha). Target: tomorrow EOD for completion.

docs-bot: Thread archived after 24h inactivity.
